title: DAO vector generator can truncate its canonical JSON on interruption
description: test/vectors/generate_dao_origin_signature.py still writes dao_origin_signature.json with Path.write_text(), unlike the other modified vector generators' same-directory fsync-and-replace helper. A process interruption, disk-full error, or serializer/write failure after truncation can leave the checked-in canonical DAO vector empty or partial; --check then only reports a parse failure and cannot recover it. Serialize first and use the shared atomic JSON writer while preserving the existing deterministic --check behavior; add injected write/replace failure coverage proving the prior destination survives.
